CustomRootTrust, NoFlag, serverAuth EKU and standard SslStream hostname verification; no permissive remote-validation callback.

foundation_review.discovery: BoxModel raw string retained; optional known classification and ignored computed members; JsonConstructor selects the string-preserving source-generated record constructor.
foundation_review.auth: Configured app_version is transmitted, unconfigured value omitted; requiredness is not invented.
foundation_review.websocket: request_id uses the documented name and is omitted when null.
foundation_review.permissions: Absent permission values become false as explicitly documented; camera recording/stream access represented; obsolete parental key excluded.

bounded_wire_unions.policy: HomeIoValue with explicit discriminator and Utf8JsonReader/Writer converter; use value_type as separate metadata. Null is permitted for documented void trigger commands only, not all updates.
A bounded object-or-array response union. An optional list view is separate from the preserved wire representation.

bounded_wire_unions.field: GET downloads / GET wifi/state / notification detail results
bounded_wire_unions.policy: Explicit generic object-or-array representation with per-operation JsonTypeInfo. Never normalize the stored form; singleton convenience accessor rejects arrays with length other than one.

bounded_wire_unions.field: StorageDisk.table_type / VoicemailEntry.country_code / Precord.id / Frecord.id / evidenced numeric-string fields
bounded_wire_unions.policy: Named per-domain scalar union retaining opaque string values including empty strings and leading zeros; numeric representation uses a range appropriate to verified field constraints. No global JsonNumberHandling coercion.
Only array or empty object is established. Reject nonempty object until a dictionary element schema is documented; an empty object does not prove arbitrary map keys.
Bounded array/map union if accepted at consolidation; only psk support is stated. Unknown future names may remain raw keys without fabricated semantics.

bounded_wire_unions.field: WifiApCapabilities bands / Media.record_time / LTE aggregation result
bounded_wire_unions.policy: Use domain-specific variants only after exact object/map value schemas and branch recognition are accepted; the existence of two shapes does not prove missing inner fields.

wire_name_policy.aliases: Store exact source keys separately, or use an explicit wire-key discriminator. Never silently collapse id/feed_id, IPv4/ipv4, icon/url, type/mode or mode/suspend conflicts.
wire_name_policy.unknown_enums: Preserve raw response tokens and offer optional known classification. Deprecated write choices remain excluded; unknown tokens do not invent semantics.
wire_name_policy.paths: Preserve raw encoded/plain path strings; use explicit conversion methods only when the corresponding endpoint encoding is established.
wire_name_policy.timestamps: Retain raw integers and per-field units. No global seconds/milliseconds rule from heterogeneous examples.

patch_policy.representation: Optional<T> with IsSet independent of Value; false and 0 remain supplied values. Nullable values accepted only on specific documented nullable request fields.
patch_policy.writer: Unset properties are omitted by the containing generated writer or explicit WhenWritingDefault metadata; a value converter alone cannot omit its containing property.
patch_policy.request_models: Distinct creation/update/action request DTOs and read DTOs. Exclude read-only members; do not assume that every PUT is a merge or that null clears a field.
patch_policy.examples: Partial source examples support individual request fields, not universal requiredness/optionality or server defaults.

generation_strategy.phase_gate: Build a normalized reviewed schema with operation-specific route/body/result, precise field access/presence/nullable states, evidence and accepted errata; then validate coverage and references before emission.
generation_strategy.recommended_default: Deterministic offline/build-time contract generation plus built-in System.Text.Json source generation, explicit JsonTypeInfo<T> everywhere.
generation_strategy.custom_roslyn_generator: Not necessary for the present foundation; introduce only if compile-time fluent facade/metadata emission offers a concrete verified benefit over reproducible generated C# files.
generation_strategy.aot: No runtime reflection, dynamic, open object payload stand-ins or globally permissive serializers. Typed bounded converters must retain wire kind and proven branches. Raw binary/unspecified-format downloads may return owned streams without fabricating JSON DTOs.
generation_strategy.di: One configured origin/application/session coordinator shared across transient immutable facades; Microsoft.Extensions.Http/IHttpClientBuilder composes the handler lifetime. Resource-specific facades share transport instead of registering separate sessions.
generation_strategy.fluent: Immutable resource selectors and per-command builders snapshotting explicit supplied fields; capability metadata does not become invented endpoint authorization.
generation_strategy.resultless_operations: An explicitly accepted success-only command may ignore an unspecified result. It must not manufacture a DTO or imply a documented result shape.
generation_strategy.bounded_unions_and_optional_presence_str: accepted_by_root_2026-10-02; individual missing schemas/routes still require consolidation

io.session_and_replay: Invalidate failed sessions and renew for the next explicit operation; no automatic mutation replay or route fallback.
io.streams: Expose explicit ownership of HttpResponseMessage/Stream and cancellation lifetime; neither buffering everything nor releasing a response before its consumer finishes.
io.websocket_upload: Current wire documentation must drive handshake/binary framing/state/correlation; do not reuse a fabricated ordinary HTTP upload route.
io.events: The supplied event inventory has four declarations. No invented Home event names or fictitious event slots.

concurrency.handler_state: Shared session/discovery coordination; command DTOs immutable snapshots. Delegating handlers and factory primary handlers have explicit ownership.
concurrency.task_inventory: 45 real module review contexts and five consolidation groups; not 45 simultaneous agents or implementation approvals.
